## 🙋‍♂️ About Me

- 🎓 **Informatics** student at **Universitas Pancasakti Tegal**
- ✍️ **AI Prompter:** I design and refine prompts for AI tools, from text to image and video generation
- 🚀 Founder of **KunzDigital**, a digital product brand: **AI prompts, eBooks, and ready-to-use templates**
- 🤖 Interested in **Artificial Intelligence**, digital entrepreneurship, and creative content production

## 🛍️ KunzDigital

> **AI · Digital Products · Technology**

Products I create and sell at [kunzdigital.lynk.id](https://kunzdigital.lynk.id):

| Product | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🧠 AI Prompts | Ready-to-use prompt collections for various needs |
| 📘 eBooks | Beginner-friendly AI guides, such as *Dasar AI untuk Pemula* and *Mengenal Kecerdasan Buatan (AI)* |
| 🎨 Templates | Ready-to-use templates for productivity and design |

## 📁 Projects

- 📘 **AI for Beginners eBook (2026 Revised Edition):** prompt engineering, DeepSeek, AI ethics, and a 7-day learning roadmap → [kunzdigital.lynk.id](https://kunzdigital.lynk.id)
- 🔐 **WannaCry ransomware analysis based on the CIA Triad:** a cybersecurity case study
- 🏛️ **Internship report at DPMPTSP Kabupaten Tegal:** digital transformation of building permits from IMB to PBG through the SIMBG platform
